object.body:
Dear $__recipient.name,

AWS Onboarding Partially Completed

Your AWS onboarding has completed with partial success. The AWS SaaS Connector has been configured and the source has been created, but some target AWS accounts could not be deployed successfully and require your attention.

#if($adminAccountId) #end
Onboarding Summary
Source Name $sourceName
Source ID $sourceId
AWS Management Account $adminAccountId
Deployment Status ⚠ Partially Completed

Deployment Statistics

#if($managementAccountSuccessful != $null)
Management Account #if($managementAccountSuccessful) ✓ Deployed successfully #else ✗ Deployment failed #end
#end
Child Accounts
$!childAccountsTotal
  
Successful
$!childAccountsSuccessful
  
Failed
$!childAccountsFailed
#if($failedAccountIds && !$failedAccountIds.isEmpty())

Failed Account IDs

$!childAccountsFailed child account#if($childAccountsFailed != 1)s#end failed deployment.

#set($shownIds = "") #set($remainingCount = 0) #foreach($accountId in $failedAccountIds) #if($foreach.count <= 100) #if($shownIds != "")#set($shownIds = "$shownIds, ")#end #set($shownIds = "$shownIds$accountId") #else #set($remainingCount = $remainingCount + 1) #end #end $shownIds#if($remainingCount > 0), and $remainingCount more — view in AWS#end

#elseif($childAccountsFailed && $childAccountsFailed > 0)

Failed Account IDs

$!childAccountsFailed child account#if($childAccountsFailed != 1)s#end failed deployment. View the source in SailPoint for account-level details.

#end

Recommended Actions

Some child AWS accounts could not be deployed successfully. Please review AWS CloudTrail logs on the target system for failure details, verify AWS permissions and service control policies (SCPs), and retry deployment for affected accounts from the source configuration page.

#set($url=$__global.productUrl + '/ui/a/admin/connections/sources/' + $sourceId)
View Source in SailPoint

Important: If Agentic Fabric has already been activated for this AWS source, you cannot make onboarding changes through SAF. To troubleshoot or make configuration changes, go to the underlying AWS source in Identity Security Cloud (ISC).

For detailed deployment and onboarding status, including account-level success or failure details, sign in to your AWS account and review the AWS onboarding logs.

Best Regards,
The SailPoint Support Team
object.description: Sent to the user when SAF AWS Onboarding completes with some failed child accounts.
object.name: SAF AWS Onboarding – Partially Completed
object.subject: SAF AWS Onboarding – Partially Completed
